method.text: Native 1000-step joint codesign. Paired LigandMPNN arm uses one sequence at 0.1, checkpoint 030, atom context on, sidechain context off, no packing. CPU MPNN adds zero GPU seconds; shared scaffold generation time is inherited, not omitted. Native APN1 composite-ligand handling of M0110 changes interface interpretation and is disclosed.

CPU MPNN adds zero GPU seconds; shared scaffold generation time is inherited, not omitted. Native APN1 composite-ligand handling of M0110 changes interface interpretation and is disclosed.

One 75/45/5/15 optimization trajectory, then one soluble ProteinMPNN v_48_020 sequence at 0.1. Three continuation gates bypassed to retain bad trajectories. No post-MPNN fold/relax/filter/rank. Native independent batch 1; exact lengths warmed. Native interface-fixed residues retained. Output sidechains incompatible with the new sequence become unobserved rather than being grafted.

native_pipeline.text: Native optimization with continuation gates and beta adaptation, relaxation, up to 20 soluble ProteinMPNN proposals and native AF2 validation; stops after at most two accepted candidates. One original designates the retained candidate with highest native Average_i_pTM regardless of native filter acceptance, using its highest-pLDDT validation model. If none remains, retain the saved trajectory. All intrinsic proposals and validations are charged. No restart to replace a rejected original. Batch size 1; separately warmed exact-length signatures. Common AF3 evaluates the designated output only.

method.text: One 50/25/45/5/15 trajectory, then one native soluble-MPNN redesign at 0.1. Continuation gates disabled; no independent validation or relaxation. Native independent batch 1, unchunked; resident AF2/MPNN pair, separately warmed signatures. Preserve exact native redesign constraints and report omitted incompatible sidechains.

native_pipeline.text: Native optimization with continuation gates, ten distinct MPNN candidates, three-recycle validation and early stop after three passing candidates. One original designates the highest native i_pDAE retained candidate regardless of native filter acceptance, or the saved trajectory if none is available. Native relaxation is disabled by default. Batch size 1, resident models, exact-length warmup; candidate history is reset per original. Intrinsic validation and selection are included in generation time, separately from common AF3.

method.text: Design: 500 steps/3 recycles; inverse folding: 200 steps/3 recycles, one final sequence. Original indices 0–99 use diverse, 100–199 adherence, preserving the native quarter settings across shards. No terminal folding/filtering/ranking. Atom hotspots become residue hotspots; PPI is all-atom. Seven heme cases use disclosed native bond-type projections; difficult chemistry uses source-derived archives, never author benchmark molecules.

Native diverse/max joint draw, 200 diffusion steps/four recycles. No extra sequence designer. SDF/JSON derives from shared CIF chemistry, never checked-in benchmark SDFs. Same-target/exact-length batches; all batch members retained. Native hydrogen/bond-order losses are documented, not repaired.

150 inversion steps, two pinned models/four intrinsic hero critics. Critic 0 is predesignated; no common-AF3 ranking. Target sequence/residue hotspots, not target coordinates. Multichain extension preserves all target copies and native whole-complex ipTM, including target–target contributions. Intrinsic critics are not separate benchmark attempts.

One 100-step generative draw and one CA-MPNN sequence at 0.1. No search or ColabFold. Force the original hotspot, using target CA and source hotspot sidechain geometry, not extended contacts. Native CA-only outputs stay CA-only and are evaluated with binder CA RMSD. Some executed input receipts reference an earlier source release; exact executed files remain preserved, not silently rebound to a newer queue.

native_pipeline.text: Separate search pipeline: 100 diffusion steps, beam width 4, scoring every 25 steps; 64 internal candidate evaluations per original. Each candidate gets one CA-MPNN sequence at temperature 0.1 and ColabFold AF2-Multimer v3, one model/three recycles with target templating. Select the global maximum negative mean interface PAE; publish its generated CA backbone, not the AF2-refolded backbone. Preserve original hotspot sidechains; no extended conditioning. Independent original batch size 1. Diffusion, MPNN and internal folding/search are all charged. The catalog currently uses an approved timing estimate: one padding-optimized measured replicate per target extrapolated to 200 originals. Common AF3 is additional and separately timed.

method.text: Native scaffold generation followed by the corrected one-LigandMPNN0.1, source-mask-fixed sequence route. No terminal AF3 selection. Native AME receives disclosed extra observed motif context and is not a strict tip-only baseline. Fixed-ligand and fixed-DNA membership is labeled explicitly. Original-generation timing is a proxy, as described above.

Native 200 steps, CFG off, step size 1.5; one LigandMPNN sequence at temperature 0.1, no downstream pipeline screening. DNA uses the DNA-finetuned checkpoint. Native JSON/derivatives preserve shared lengths and correspondence. Approved PPI OXT omission and native M0110 bond/charge/preprocessing losses are retained. Ligands can follow native reference conformers; no stereo repair.

Seven approved native refinement cycles, 100%-X initialization, 200 steps/3 recycles, MPNN 0.1. SolubleMPNN for PPI; LigandMPNN for ligands/DNA. Retain highest native ipTM cycle among those with ≤20% alanine. All intrinsic cycles are timed. Native rejection and writer/chemistry defects are not rescued. PPI guidance is residue hotspots and CA/CB/frame guidance, not hard sidechain enforcement.

One 400-step joint draw, no additional MPNN/selection. PPI uses V1; AME V2/LoRA32; fixed small molecules use the corrected dedicated V1/LoRA32 ligand route. Native matcher is retained: unmatched motifs fail downstream. PPI and ligand inputs use native atom37/template features and residue-projected hotspots. No DNA or fully unfixed ligand route.

Joint sequence/structure generation with stored Low/Medium/High schedules; exact schedule/checkpoint comes from each native config. Search is a separate intrinsic workflow: AF2-Multimer for PPI and OF3 for the other benchmarks, with all search work timed. Preserve native motif correspondence; unmatched required motifs fail. Historical PPI-AA validation is explicitly separate from the newer BB campaign.

50-step Complex_base draw with example CA/frame noise scales 0; one ProteinMPNN v_48_020 sequence at 0.1. Resident native batch 1. No Rosetta/refold/selection. Explicit contig/chain maps retain target copies and gaps. Preserve native backbone-only output and atom omissions.

AME RFD_140 checkpoint, 100 native flow steps, one LigandMPNN 0.1 sequence with native packing/context. Resident native batch 1. M0110 uses the explicitly approved disconnected ligand projection: preserve source atoms/coordinates but omit two bonds in the native derivative. This is not equivalent physical topology. Native guidepost matching/idealization is retained.

Native Protenix refinement pipeline: 10 cycles, 150 refinement steps, two MPNN proposals and five ranked predictions; Protenix model_beta1_v0.2.0.pt with 10 model recycles/200 prediction steps. PPI enables interaction optimization and selection from cycle 0. DNA starts from the shared unfixed target sequences and uses the 120–150-residue binder queue. Target sequences are retained, not hard target-coordinate templates. Final cycle skips coordinate refinement; designate its first native eval_plddt-ranked packed structure with its MPNN sequence. No common-AF3 selection or acceptance restarts. Native batch size 1; intrinsic MPNN/cofolding/selection is generation compute.
